# Foreturn IQ

> Food and beverage pre-ordering for golf courses. Golfers scan a QR code on the cart and order from their own phone, no app or account. The kitchen gets a timed queue that shows when to start prep. No hardware, no POS integration needed.

Built for golf course general managers, assistant managers and F&B directors.

## How it works
- Golfers choose a pickup window: Before Round, At the Turn or After Round.
- Orders land in a kitchen queue bucketed Prepare Now, Coming Up, Later Today, with each golfer's predicted arrival and when to start prep.
- Golfers are asked to share their phone's location. If they allow it, the prep window tightens as they get closer to pickup; if they decline, the order runs on the estimated arrival time.
- Every order gets a 4-character pickup code.
- Payments settle directly to the course's own Stripe account.

## Pricing
- Free for the course: no hardware, no setup charge, no subscription.
- Golfers pay a service fee of 5% of their order plus $0.50 (e.g. $1.48 on a $19.50 order).
- The course keeps 100% of its menu prices, plus tax and tips.

- [Hot Food at the Turn](https://foreturniq.com/hot-food-at-the-turn): timing turn food to the golfer's real pace of play so it is hot on arrival
- [Short-Staffed Kitchens](https://foreturniq.com/short-staffed-golf-kitchen): running the grill with one cook using a queue sorted by arrival
- [After-Round Orders](https://foreturniq.com/after-round-food-orders): after-round and to-go orders placed on the back nine, ready as golfers finish
